fixtures.commitChain: First creates seven selected paths; second adds only unselected.txt; third changes selected ASCII bytes. Helper selects exact second and reviewed first.
fixtures.mode: Git index records bin/tool.sh100755; file is never executed
fixtures.rollover: Separate owned repo, three distinct3000000-byte bodies; two actual blob batches plus one commit batch
fixtures.environment: Dedicated test process temporarily removes inherited credentials/proxies/Git overrides; only OS executable-path inputs plus closed local-only Git settings are supplied. Original process environment and patched built-in restored in finally.
fixtures.network: No HTTP,remote server,API,provider or credential operation. Git protocol allowlist is file; fixture never creates a remote.
fixtures.countBoundary: Additional owned repo with97 unique tiny files;97 actual descriptors,96 selected positive, then upper-count refusal with no child

bounds.cleanup: Only the exact mkdtemp root, verified canonical parent/prefix/non-symlink; force:false,maxRetries:0

unimplemented.scope: Actual owned promisor repository/no object auto-install
unimplemented.reason: G08 proves a regular missing object refuses and the no-lazy-fetch flag is passed; it does not prove an actual promisor fetch side-effect path. A bounded local-file-only promisor fixture is still needed.
G05 proves actual regular/executable mismatch; T05 proves parser rejection of symlink/tree/submodule modes. No real non-blob index fixture is created.

unimplemented.scope: Real elapsed deadline, OS child termination and cleanup
unimplemented.reason: F01-F07 supply simulated process return/throw failures through a restored built-in boundary. No monotonic clock is patched, no90-second wall-time proof or real OS timeout/kill is claimed. Adding a genuine process fixture or reviewed injection seam is separate work.

unimplemented.scope: Retained release-policy, provider, review-pin and changed-set final fences
unimplemented.reason: The harness never imports caller/action tools or current bindings and never queries APIs. A separate fully owned caller fixture is required; parser/Git success cannot qualify those fences.

unimplemented.scope: More than30 selected commit objects and whole-invocation64MB body rollover
unimplemented.reason: Actual fixtures cover two selected commits and real9MB blob rollover. V07 checks the64MB descriptor refusal before reading; actual multi-commit-batch boundaries and64MB memory behavior are not exercised.

Cleanup code is bounded to the freshly created realpath-verified root, but actual Windows Git launch, Unicode/mode behavior, child cleanup and built-in export restoration still need a real owned Windows run.

limits: No case executed or collected during source preparation
41 children plus one parent are authored; Node reporter counting is not manufactured from authored group counts
Process return simulations are not native timeout/child-cleanup proof
No caller/action/production qualification, speed measurement or current-release gate

causalRepairs.positive: Actual owned repo contains97 unique files;96,1 and2 valid selected rows succeed
causalRepairs.negative: 97 unique otherwise-valid actual path descriptors refuse with zero child calls; duplicate arm remains separate
causalRepairs.causal: A broken maximum guard cannot borrow duplicate-path refusal
causalRepairs.remaining: All controls are authored only, not run

causalRepairs.positive: Valid UTF-8 encoding of the U+FFFD replacement-decoded path is accepted under that requested name
causalRepairs.negative: Raw c3 28 bytes request the exact same replacement-decoded name and must throw TypeError/ERR_ENCODING_INVALID_ENCODED_DATA
causalRepairs.causal: A nonfatal lossy decoder would otherwise match the requested set

causalRepairs.positive: Authentic complete binary frame succeeds; high-bit OID mutation is asserted to ASCII-decode to the identical valid header
causalRepairs.negative: High-bit alias on an existing OID byte must produce Boolean AssertionError refusal
causalRepairs.causal: Without strict ASCII-byte checking all subsequent framing/OID/body predicates would still match
causalRepairs.auxiliary: Overlong-header layered refusal remains, without claiming it is an isolated grammar-free limit witness

causalRepairs.positive: Extend actual first owned commit body to262144 bytes, recompute real OID/frame, and accept; also accept three complete blobs totaling8000000 bytes
causalRepairs.negative: Complete authentic262145-byte commit refuses; three complete individually admissible blob frames totaling8000001 bytes refuse
causalRepairs.causal: Missing-body/trailer/malformed-object rejection cannot substitute for either size boundary
causalRepairs.auxiliary: Original all-zero oversized-output arm retained as layered refusal only; F06 supplies isolated process-output category proof

causalRepairs.positive: Real owned helper pass verifies genuine output fits each requested process cap
causalRepairs.negative: Append beyond the process cap to a genuine valid first batch response; require ERR_ASSERTION with exact RELEASE_GIT_BATCH_BOUND_EXCEEDED plus one call/no retry/sanitization
causalRepairs.causal: Later parser failure cannot satisfy the exact bound category

causalRepairs.positive: After deliberate failing case body, default property and named live ESM export both already equal originalSpawn; directly call the helper without interception
causalRepairs.negative: A missing restoration sync would leave the named binding stale before another installation could mask it
causalRepairs.causal: No withSpawn installation occurs between restoration observation and the actual unwrapped owned helper call
causalRepairs.cleanup: Nested finally restores CJS/ESM again even if the unwrapped control fails
causalRepairs.bounds: Unwrapped control uses original helper native30s per-child bound, not the hooked10s delegation; existing240s/210s harness bounds unchanged

revisionMeaning: Same41 authored child labels/slots and one parent; zero collection/execution; V1 remains immutable and its negative review is preserved
